lines.zh: 我贴着酸液边跑，脚不沾。
lines.en: I run along the acid's edge, feet dry.

lines.zh: 我走过的地面，酸液往旁退。
lines.en: Where I walk, acid draws aside.
Tail up, my steps are light.
I weave through the cavern.
I pause and twitch my ears.

lines.zh: 我踩过石头，石头蚀了一点。
lines.en: I tread on stone; it etches a little.

lines.zh: 我朝没有酸雾的方向走。
lines.en: I head away from the acid mist.
I keep to the dry strip along the wall.

lines.zh: 我一跳，从一块岩跳到另一块。
lines.en: I hop from rock to rock.
I walk slowly, sniffing.

lines.zh: 我绕开一滩发亮的液体。
lines.en: I skirt a pool of something glowing.

lines.zh: 我离你还有一段距离就停下。
lines.en: I stop a good distance from you.

lines.zh: 我抬脚，避开了地上的绿沫。
lines.en: I lift a paw clear of the green froth.

lines.zh: 我的毛在暗处泛一点光。
lines.en: My fur carries a faint glow in the dark.
I take two more steps and look back at you.

lines.zh: 我走到洞底的水边站住。
lines.en: I stop by the water at the cavern's floor.
I sit, tail curled to my feet.

lines.zh: 我身上很干净，一滴酸也没沾。
lines.en: I am clean. Not a drop of acid on me.
I watch the acid mist in the distance.

lines.zh: 我低头舔自己胸前那块毛。
lines.en: I lower my head and lick the fur on my chest.
Ears up, I listen to the dripping.
This air does not bother me.

lines.zh: 我眨了两下眼，光暗了一瞬。
lines.en: I blink twice and my glow dims for a moment.
I have sat at the cave mouth a long while.

lines.zh: 我动了一下，身上的光跟着动。
lines.en: I move, and my glow moves with me.
I tuck my head into my forelegs.

lines.zh: 我张嘴打哈欠，牙露了一下。
lines.en: I yawn and flash my teeth.
This place does not frighten me at all.
I wait for you to come closer.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴从一边甩到另一边。
lines.en: I swing my tail from one side to the other.

lines.zh: 我抬头，眼睛在暗里很亮。
lines.en: I look up; my eyes are bright in the dark.
You are in the acid mist. I am fine.
I come closer and circle you, sniffing.
Your smell stings a little.

lines.zh: 我坐到你面前，尾巴慢慢摆。
lines.en: I sit before you, tail moving slowly.

lines.zh: 我伸爪碰了碰你的靴尖。
lines.en: I touch your boot tip with a paw.
You mean no harm. I do not flinch.
I tilt my head to look at you.
I bring my nose to your hand.

lines.zh: 我没出声，只把脸转向你。
lines.en: I make no sound and just turn my face to you.
I circle behind you and return.
I settle at your feet.

lines.zh: 我的光把这里照出一小圈。
lines.en: My glow lights a small circle here.
You step back. I do not follow.
I leap back and flatten.
My fur is a mess.
I shrink back behind a stone.
I let out half a short cry.

lines.zh: 我扭头去舔被抓到的地方。
lines.en: I twist around to lick where I was clawed.
I tuck my tail down.
I give two more steps of ground.
My glow grows brighter.
I crouch and creep.

lines.zh: 我转身就往干地那边跑。
lines.en: I turn and run for the dry ground.
That smells like radgill.
I go to it at once.

lines.zh: 我小心地咬住，不碰到你的手。
lines.en: I take it carefully, clear of your fingers.
I eat slowly, sniffing first.
I'm not full yet. A little more.

lines.zh: 我仰着脸看你，眼睛睁得很大。
lines.en: I look up at you with my eyes wide.

lines.zh: 我绕到你另一侧再靠近。
lines.en: I circle to your other side before coming closer.
I rest a forepaw on your leg.
Finished, I lick my lips.
I sit again, closer than before.
I push my head into your hand.
Any more? I will wait.

lines.zh: 我从喉咙里挤出一声轻响。
lines.en: I squeeze a soft sound from my throat.

lines.zh: 我吃完，跟着你走了两步。
lines.en: Having eaten, I follow you two steps.

lines.zh: 被撞的地方有点疼，我让开。
lines.en: The spot hurts a little, so I step away.
I turn a little sideways.

lines.zh: 我绕开你，回到原来的位置。
lines.en: I go around you and return to my spot.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴被踩住，赶紧抽出来。
lines.en: My tail was pinned, so I pull it free.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，我一点没慌。
lines.en: We collide; I am not startled at all.
I back off, tail still up.
I am not remotely provoked.
I brush past your knee.
I plant my feet and watch you.

lines.zh: 我侧身退到一边，让你走。
lines.en: I step aside and let you pass.
Another comes from the acid pool's edge.
We sniff nose to nose.
I rest my head against its neck.

lines.zh: 它的舌头蹭过我的耳根。
lines.en: Its tongue brushes the base of my ear.

lines.zh: 我们一起在干地上坐下。
lines.en: We sit together on dry ground.
Its fur is a little darker than mine.

lines.zh: 我们并排趴着，谁也不动。
lines.en: We lie side by side, neither moving.
It looks deeper into the cave.
We walk back to the cave mouth together.
It sleeps first. I stay awake.
I carry it over and set it before your feet.

lines.zh: 我拿爪子把东西推来推去。
lines.en: I push the thing back and forth with a paw.

lines.zh: 我闻了一下，不是能吃的。
lines.en: I sniff once. Not something to eat.
I bat it in front of you.
It is warm. I let go.
I carry it off and stuff it into a crevice.
I carry it a few paces.
I set it down and look up at you.

lines.zh: 它沾了一点酸，我避开了。
lines.en: It has acid on it. I keep clear.

lines.zh: 我把它推到你脚前，不拿走。
lines.en: I nudge it to your feet and leave it.
I do not like the look of you.

lines.zh: 我撑着前爪慢慢立起身。
lines.en: I push up on my forepaws and rise.
I retreat to the edge of dry ground.

lines.zh: 我背上的毛一下全炸开。
lines.en: The fur on my back puffs up all at once.

lines.zh: 我盯着你手里的东西不放。
lines.en: I keep my eyes on what's in your hand.
I begin a low sound.
I have your position noted.
I edge toward the cave mouth.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，尾巴贴住酸地。
lines.en: I flatten down, tail pressed to the acid ground.

lines.zh: 我后腿绷紧，随时能冲出去。
lines.en: My hind legs are coiled to bolt.
I circle you, keeping my distance.

lines.zh: 你刚抬手，我就后撤一步。
lines.en: The moment you raise a hand, I step back.
I stay near the cave mouth.
My tail is held high.
I do not cry out. I only rumble low.

lines.zh: 我从一滩酸液边绕过去。
lines.en: I go around a pool of acid.
If you chase, I dive into the narrow ways.
I stop and look back.
You cannot reach me.

lines.zh: 我退到酸雾够不到的地方。
lines.en: I back off to where the acid mist can't reach.
I lunge and claw you once.
I bite and let go at once.
I kick you with my hind legs.
I hit your leg and bounce off.
That swipe goes wide.
I back off, fur on end.
I rake your hand from the side.
I cry out as I retreat.
I duck behind a stone.

lines.zh: 我又从石头后面探出脑袋。
lines.en: I poke my head out from behind the stone again.
I walk out of the acid mist.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖毛，一滴酸也没沾。
lines.en: I shake my coat. No acid on me.
I move to the dry ground.
I look around the cavern.
I lick my paws first.
My fur glows in the dark.
I sit and listen to the water.
I know it is safe here.
I look toward the movement.
I take my first slow step.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的毛，我赶紧滚了一圈。
lines.en: Fire catches my fur; I roll once to put it out.

lines.zh: 我从岩架掉下来，落地打了个滚。
lines.en: I fall from the ledge and roll on landing.
Water covers me and I kick wildly.
The blast throws me into the rock.
The arrowhead is stuck in my shoulder.
That light whites out my sight.
My belly is so empty I can't even jump.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我整只跳了起来。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and I leap straight up.

lines.zh: 黑暗里没有落脚的地方。
lines.en: There is nowhere to land in the dark.
